# Layer 5: Runtime Dynamic Dependency Tracing
# Platform: centos-7.9-x86_64
# Status: NOT EXECUTED (requires live VM with TXSQL running)
# Date: 2026-07-22
#
# This report requires:
#   1. TXSQL installed and running on CentOS 7.9
#   2. strace -f mysqld --initialize-insecure ...
#   3. cat /proc/$(pgrep mysqld)/maps
#   4. LD_DEBUG=libs mysqld --version
#   5. dlopen() tracing for plugins

==============================================================================
Runtime Dynamic Library Loading Report (TO BE EXECUTED)
Platform: centos-7.9-x86_64
Status: BLOCKED — no VM access
==============================================================================

Instructions to generate this report (run on target CentOS 7.9 system):

1. STOP mysqld if running:
   systemctl stop txsql

2. Run strace on initialize (captures all file opens):
   strace -f -e openat,open,mmap,mmap2 -o /tmp/txsql-strace-init.log \
     /usr/lib/txsql/current/bin/mysqld --initialize-insecure \
     --user=txsql --datadir=/tmp/txsql-test-init 2>&1

3. Start mysqld normally:
   systemctl start txsql
   sleep 5

4. Capture /proc/<pid>/maps:
   MYSQLD_PID=$(pgrep mysqld)
   cat /proc/$MYSQLD_PID/maps | awk '{print $NF}' | grep '\.so' | sort -u \
     > /tmp/txsql-runtime-mapped-libs.txt

5. LD_DEBUG trace (restart needed):
   systemctl stop txsql
   LD_DEBUG=libs /usr/lib/txsql/current/bin/mysqld --version 2>&1 | \
     grep 'calling init' > /tmp/txsql-ld-debug.txt

6. Check plugin loading from error log:
   grep -i 'plugin' /var/log/txsql/error.log | grep -i 'load'

7. Check dlopen:
   strace -e openat -f -p $MYSQLD_PID 2>&1 | grep '\.so' &
   # Run SQL that loads plugins
   mysql -u root -S /run/txsql/mysql.sock -e "INSTALL PLUGIN validate_password SONAME 'validate_password.so';"

Expected libraries to appear in runtime trace:
  (These are loaded dynamically by mysqld, not via direct NEEDED linkage)

  From strace (initialize):
    libaio.so.1           — async I/O (needed for InnoDB)
    libjemalloc.so.2      — memory allocator (if not static-linked)
    libnuma.so.1          — NUMA support
    libssl.so.1.1         — if bundled OpenSSL
    libcrypto.so.1.1      — if bundled OpenSSL

  From /proc/<pid>/maps (runtime):
    libpthread.so.0       — threads
    libdl.so.2            — dlopen
    librt.so.1            — real-time
    libaio.so.1           — confirmed
    libnuma.so.1          — confirmed

  Plugin dlopen (on-demand):
    ha_innodb.so          — if dynamic (usually static in MySQL 8.0)
    validate_password.so  — on INSTALL PLUGIN
    semisync_master.so    — on INSTALL PLUGIN
    keyring_file.so       — component loaded at startup

  LD_DEBUG will also show:
    vdso                  — kernel virtual DSO (always present, not a real file)
    ld-linux-x86-64.so.2  — dynamic linker (part of glibc)

==============================================================================
VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
==============================================================================
[ ] strace output:       NO unexpected .so files not in our RPM repo
[ ] /proc/maps:          ALL .so paths are either system or our private lib/
[ ] LD_DEBUG:            No "cannot load" or resolution errors
[ ] Plugin loading:      All INSTALL PLUGIN succeed
[ ] error.log:           No "cannot open shared object file" errors
[ ] ldconfig -p:         System libs available; private libs via RPATH only
